title: The Headless Horseman: A Strange Tale of Texas
sourceTitle: The Headless Horseman: A Strange Tale of Texas
author: Mayne Reid
description: "The Headless Horseman: A Strange Tale of Texas" by Mayne Reid is a novel published in 1866, based on the author's American adventures and a South Texas folk tale.
longDescription: Set in Texas after the Mexican-American War, the story follows beautiful Louise Poindexter, courted by two rivals: the vindictive Cassius Calhoun and the dashing mustanger Maurice Gerald.

authorInfo.bio: Mayne Reid (1818–1883) wrote Quadrupeds, What They Are and Where Found: A Book of Zoology for Boys. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
